colormaps.name: viridis
colormaps.description: Default perceptually-uniform sequential. Safe baseline for scalar fields.
colormaps.citation: Smith & van der Walt (2015), 'A Better Default Colormap for Matplotlib', SciPy talk
colormaps.license: matplotlib (BSD-style; https://matplotlib.org/stable/users/project/license.html)

colormaps.name: magma
colormaps.description: Dark→bright with warm hues. Higher chroma than viridis.
colormaps.citation: Smith & van der Walt (2015), 'A Better Default Colormap for Matplotlib', SciPy talk
colormaps.license: matplotlib (BSD-style; https://matplotlib.org/stable/users/project/license.html)

colormaps.name: plasma
colormaps.description: Purple→yellow ramp; high chroma across the range.
colormaps.citation: Smith & van der Walt (2015), 'A Better Default Colormap for Matplotlib', SciPy talk
colormaps.license: matplotlib (BSD-style; https://matplotlib.org/stable/users/project/license.html)

colormaps.name: inferno
colormaps.description: Most aggressive luminance ramp; black→bright yellow through red.
colormaps.citation: Smith & van der Walt (2015), 'A Better Default Colormap for Matplotlib', SciPy talk
colormaps.license: matplotlib (BSD-style; https://matplotlib.org/stable/users/project/license.html)

colormaps.name: cividis
colormaps.description: Color-vision-deficiency safe alternative to viridis.
colormaps.citation: Nuñez, Anderton & Renslow (2018), PLOS ONE, doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0199239
colormaps.license: matplotlib (BSD-style; https://matplotlib.org/stable/users/project/license.html)

colormaps.name: turbo
colormaps.description: High-contrast rainbow alternative to jet. Not perceptually uniform; use when discriminating bands matters more than ordering.
colormaps.citation: Mikhailov (2019), 'Turbo, An Improved Rainbow Colormap for Visualization', Google AI Blog
colormaps.license: matplotlib (BSD-style; https://matplotlib.org/stable/users/project/license.html)

colormaps.name: thermal
colormaps.description: Heat-like; deep blue→bright yellow. Good for energy / activity magnitude.
colormaps.citation: Thyng et al. (2016), 'True colors of oceanography', Oceanography 29(3), doi:10.5670/oceanog.2016.66
colormaps.license: cmocean by Kristen Thyng (MIT; https://github.com/matplotlib/cmocean)

colormaps.name: haline
colormaps.description: Deep blue→pale yellow; oceanographic salinity but a usable general sequential.
colormaps.license: cmocean by Kristen Thyng (MIT; https://github.com/matplotlib/cmocean)

colormaps.name: ice
colormaps.description: Dark blue→white. Reads as 'cold magnitude' or 'depth'.
colormaps.license: cmocean by Kristen Thyng (MIT; https://github.com/matplotlib/cmocean)

colormaps.name: amp
colormaps.description: White→deep red. Single-tail amplitude; reads as 'intensity from baseline'.
colormaps.license: cmocean by Kristen Thyng (MIT; https://github.com/matplotlib/cmocean)

colormaps.name: coolwarm
colormaps.description: Moreland's smooth diverging. Recommended default for signed anomaly fields.
colormaps.citation: Moreland (2009), 'Diverging Color Maps for Scientific Visualization', Proc. ISVC
colormaps.license: matplotlib (BSD-style; https://matplotlib.org/stable/users/project/license.html)

colormaps.name: RdBu_r
colormaps.description: Red-positive / blue-negative. Common neuroscience activation convention.
colormaps.license: matplotlib (BSD-style; https://matplotlib.org/stable/users/project/license.html)

colormaps.name: BrBG
colormaps.description: Brown↔teal terrain-style diverging. Useful when red/blue clashes with overlay colors.
colormaps.license: matplotlib (BSD-style; https://matplotlib.org/stable/users/project/license.html)

colormaps.name: balance
colormaps.description: Perceptually-uniform diverging blue→white→red. Anomalies around zero.
colormaps.license: cmocean by Kristen Thyng (MIT; https://github.com/matplotlib/cmocean)

colormaps.name: delta
colormaps.description: PU diverging with a clear white center; emphasizes near-zero values.
colormaps.license: cmocean by Kristen Thyng (MIT; https://github.com/matplotlib/cmocean)

colormaps.name: curl
colormaps.description: Magenta↔cyan PU diverging. Suited to vortices / curl-style fields.
colormaps.license: cmocean by Kristen Thyng (MIT; https://github.com/matplotlib/cmocean)

colormaps.name: twilight
colormaps.description: Perceptually-uniform cyclic; first and last colors match. Use for phase / orientation.
colormaps.citation: van der Walt (matplotlib core team), contributed for matplotlib 3.0
colormaps.license: matplotlib (BSD-style; https://matplotlib.org/stable/users/project/license.html)

colormaps.name: phase
colormaps.description: PU cyclic with higher chroma than twilight. Designed for oceanographic phase data.
colormaps.license: cmocean by Kristen Thyng (MIT; https://github.com/matplotlib/cmocean)

colormaps.name: tab10
colormaps.description: 10 distinct categorical colors. Sampled to 256 produces banded output (banding is the point).
colormaps.license: matplotlib (BSD-style; https://matplotlib.org/stable/users/project/license.html)

colormaps.name: Set2
colormaps.description: 8 softer pastel categories. Lower contrast than tab10; good for dense legends.
colormaps.license: matplotlib (BSD-style; https://matplotlib.org/stable/users/project/license.html)

colormaps.name: batlow
colormaps.description: Crameri's flagship sequential map; high chroma with monotonic luminance, the recommended scientific default.
colormaps.citation: Crameri (2018), Geosci. Model Dev., doi:10.5194/gmd-11-2541-2018; data: doi:10.5281/zenodo.8409685
colormaps.license: Crameri scientific colour maps by Fabio Crameri (MIT; doi:10.5281/zenodo.8409685; https://www.fabiocrameri.ch/colourmaps) via cmcrameri by Callum Rollo (MIT; https://github.com/callumrollo/cmcrameri)

colormaps.name: lajolla
colormaps.description: Sand → deep red. Warm sequential alternative to inferno; reads as 'temperature' or 'intensity'.
colormaps.license: Crameri scientific colour maps by Fabio Crameri (MIT; doi:10.5281/zenodo.8409685; https://www.fabiocrameri.ch/colourmaps) via cmcrameri by Callum Rollo (MIT; https://github.com/callumrollo/cmcrameri)

colormaps.name: hawaii
colormaps.description: Magenta → tan, high chroma but PU. Strong hue contrast for crowded scalar fields.
colormaps.license: Crameri scientific colour maps by Fabio Crameri (MIT; doi:10.5281/zenodo.8409685; https://www.fabiocrameri.ch/colourmaps) via cmcrameri by Callum Rollo (MIT; https://github.com/callumrollo/cmcrameri)

colormaps.name: oslo
colormaps.description: Dark navy → near-white. PU alternative to ice; cooler tones, well-separated luminance.
colormaps.license: Crameri scientific colour maps by Fabio Crameri (MIT; doi:10.5281/zenodo.8409685; https://www.fabiocrameri.ch/colourmaps) via cmcrameri by Callum Rollo (MIT; https://github.com/callumrollo/cmcrameri)

colormaps.name: davos
colormaps.description: Deep blue → near-white, near-monochromatic. PU alternative to oslo with cooler mid-tones; reads as 'cool magnitude'.
colormaps.license: Crameri scientific colour maps by Fabio Crameri (MIT; doi:10.5281/zenodo.8409685; https://www.fabiocrameri.ch/colourmaps) via cmcrameri by Callum Rollo (MIT; https://github.com/callumrollo/cmcrameri)

colormaps.name: lapaz
colormaps.description: Dark purple-blue → warm tan. Two-hue PU sequential with strong luminance ramp; warm complement to davos/oslo.
colormaps.license: Crameri scientific colour maps by Fabio Crameri (MIT; doi:10.5281/zenodo.8409685; https://www.fabiocrameri.ch/colourmaps) via cmcrameri by Callum Rollo (MIT; https://github.com/callumrollo/cmcrameri)

colormaps.name: grayC
colormaps.description: Black → white achromatic PU sequential. Crameri's perceptually-uniform alternative to matplotlib's gray; 'C' = continuous.
colormaps.license: Crameri scientific colour maps by Fabio Crameri (MIT; doi:10.5281/zenodo.8409685; https://www.fabiocrameri.ch/colourmaps) via cmcrameri by Callum Rollo (MIT; https://github.com/callumrollo/cmcrameri)

colormaps.name: acton
colormaps.description: White → deep purple. Cleanest monochromatic purple PU sequential; covers a hue gap not addressed by cmocean or colorcet shorthand maps.
colormaps.license: Crameri scientific colour maps by Fabio Crameri (MIT; doi:10.5281/zenodo.8409685; https://www.fabiocrameri.ch/colourmaps) via cmcrameri by Callum Rollo (MIT; https://github.com/callumrollo/cmcrameri)

colormaps.name: bilbao
colormaps.description: White → deep red-brown. Earthy warm monochromatic; reads as 'rust' or 'sediment magnitude'.
colormaps.license: Crameri scientific colour maps by Fabio Crameri (MIT; doi:10.5281/zenodo.8409685; https://www.fabiocrameri.ch/colourmaps) via cmcrameri by Callum Rollo (MIT; https://github.com/callumrollo/cmcrameri)

colormaps.name: vik
colormaps.description: The most-cited Crameri diverging map. Deep blue ↔ deep red through near-white. Recommended for signed anomaly fields.
colormaps.license: Crameri scientific colour maps by Fabio Crameri (MIT; doi:10.5281/zenodo.8409685; https://www.fabiocrameri.ch/colourmaps) via cmcrameri by Callum Rollo (MIT; https://github.com/callumrollo/cmcrameri)

colormaps.name: bam
colormaps.description: Pink/violet ↔ green PU diverging. Use when red/blue palettes clash with overlay colors.
colormaps.license: Crameri scientific colour maps by Fabio Crameri (MIT; doi:10.5281/zenodo.8409685; https://www.fabiocrameri.ch/colourmaps) via cmcrameri by Callum Rollo (MIT; https://github.com/callumrollo/cmcrameri)

colormaps.name: cork
colormaps.description: Green ↔ purple PU diverging. Distinctive hue pair, good for differentiating diverging fields side-by-side.
colormaps.license: Crameri scientific colour maps by Fabio Crameri (MIT; doi:10.5281/zenodo.8409685; https://www.fabiocrameri.ch/colourmaps) via cmcrameri by Callum Rollo (MIT; https://github.com/callumrollo/cmcrameri)

colormaps.name: vikO
colormaps.description: Cyclic variant of vik (the trailing O suffix marks Crameri's cyclic variants). Sharper hue contrast than twilight.
colormaps.license: Crameri scientific colour maps by Fabio Crameri (MIT; doi:10.5281/zenodo.8409685; https://www.fabiocrameri.ch/colourmaps) via cmcrameri by Callum Rollo (MIT; https://github.com/callumrollo/cmcrameri)

colormaps.name: fire
colormaps.description: Kovesi CET_L3 — perceptually-uniform black → red → yellow → white. Alternative to inferno with cleaner luminance ramp.
colormaps.citation: Kovesi (2015), 'Good Colour Maps: How to Design Them', arXiv:1509.03700
colormaps.license: colorcet — primarily Peter Kovesi's CET perceptually-uniform colour maps (CC-BY-4.0; Kovesi 2015 arXiv:1509.03700; https://colorcet.com) via the colorcet package by HoloViz (CC-BY-4.0; https://github.com/holoviz/colorcet)

colormaps.name: kbc
colormaps.description: Kovesi CET_L7 — black → blue → cyan. PU alternative to ice/oslo with brighter mid-range.
colormaps.license: colorcet — primarily Peter Kovesi's CET perceptually-uniform colour maps (CC-BY-4.0; Kovesi 2015 arXiv:1509.03700; https://colorcet.com) via the colorcet package by HoloViz (CC-BY-4.0; https://github.com/holoviz/colorcet)

colormaps.name: bgy
colormaps.description: Kovesi CET_L9 — blue → green → yellow. PU alternative to viridis with cooler midtones.
colormaps.license: colorcet — primarily Peter Kovesi's CET perceptually-uniform colour maps (CC-BY-4.0; Kovesi 2015 arXiv:1509.03700; https://colorcet.com) via the colorcet package by HoloViz (CC-BY-4.0; https://github.com/holoviz/colorcet)

colormaps.name: bmw
colormaps.description: Kovesi blue → magenta → white. Distinctive hue path; good for fields where red/yellow palettes are reserved for other channels.
colormaps.license: colorcet — primarily Peter Kovesi's CET perceptually-uniform colour maps (CC-BY-4.0; Kovesi 2015 arXiv:1509.03700; https://colorcet.com) via the colorcet package by HoloViz (CC-BY-4.0; https://github.com/holoviz/colorcet)

colormaps.name: kr
colormaps.description: Kovesi black → red PU sequential. Dark-anchored monochromatic red; complements amp (white-anchored).
colormaps.license: colorcet — primarily Peter Kovesi's CET perceptually-uniform colour maps (CC-BY-4.0; Kovesi 2015 arXiv:1509.03700; https://colorcet.com) via the colorcet package by HoloViz (CC-BY-4.0; https://github.com/holoviz/colorcet)

colormaps.name: kg
colormaps.description: Kovesi black → green PU sequential. Dark-anchored monochromatic green; counterpart to kr/kb in the RGB triad.
colormaps.license: colorcet — primarily Peter Kovesi's CET perceptually-uniform colour maps (CC-BY-4.0; Kovesi 2015 arXiv:1509.03700; https://colorcet.com) via the colorcet package by HoloViz (CC-BY-4.0; https://github.com/holoviz/colorcet)

colormaps.name: kb
colormaps.description: Kovesi black → blue PU sequential. Pure-blue monochromatic; distinct from kbc which veers cyan in the upper range.
colormaps.license: colorcet — primarily Peter Kovesi's CET perceptually-uniform colour maps (CC-BY-4.0; Kovesi 2015 arXiv:1509.03700; https://colorcet.com) via the colorcet package by HoloViz (CC-BY-4.0; https://github.com/holoviz/colorcet)

colormaps.name: bkr
colormaps.description: Kovesi CET_D1 — blue ↔ black ↔ red. PU diverging with dark center; emphasises high-magnitude tails.
colormaps.license: colorcet — primarily Peter Kovesi's CET perceptually-uniform colour maps (CC-BY-4.0; Kovesi 2015 arXiv:1509.03700; https://colorcet.com) via the colorcet package by HoloViz (CC-BY-4.0; https://github.com/holoviz/colorcet)

colormaps.name: bjy
colormaps.description: Kovesi CET_D7 — blue ↔ yellow PU diverging through near-white. Different hue pair from coolwarm/vik.
colormaps.license: colorcet — primarily Peter Kovesi's CET perceptually-uniform colour maps (CC-BY-4.0; Kovesi 2015 arXiv:1509.03700; https://colorcet.com) via the colorcet package by HoloViz (CC-BY-4.0; https://github.com/holoviz/colorcet)

colormaps.name: cjm
colormaps.description: Kovesi isoluminant diverging cyan ↔ magenta through jade (L=75). Use for signed data overlaid on grayscale imagery — luminance stays constant so the underlying structure reads through. Not a general-purpose diverging map (luminance discrimination beats hue).
colormaps.license: colorcet — primarily Peter Kovesi's CET perceptually-uniform colour maps (CC-BY-4.0; Kovesi 2015 arXiv:1509.03700; https://colorcet.com) via the colorcet package by HoloViz (CC-BY-4.0; https://github.com/holoviz/colorcet)

colormaps.name: cjo
colormaps.description: Kovesi isoluminant diverging cyan ↔ orange through jade (L=70). Alternate hue axis to cjm; same overlay-on-grayscale use case.
colormaps.license: colorcet — primarily Peter Kovesi's CET perceptually-uniform colour maps (CC-BY-4.0; Kovesi 2015 arXiv:1509.03700; https://colorcet.com) via the colorcet package by HoloViz (CC-BY-4.0; https://github.com/holoviz/colorcet)

colormaps.name: colorwheel
colormaps.description: Kovesi cyclic isoluminant colorwheel. Perfect hue rotation for phase / orientation fields.
colormaps.license: colorcet — primarily Peter Kovesi's CET perceptually-uniform colour maps (CC-BY-4.0; Kovesi 2015 arXiv:1509.03700; https://colorcet.com) via the colorcet package by HoloViz (CC-BY-4.0; https://github.com/holoviz/colorcet)

colormaps.name: glasbey
colormaps.description: Glasbey et al. max-distinct categorical palette. Far more distinct categories than tab10/Set2 (256 maximally distinguishable colors).
colormaps.citation: Glasbey, van der Heijden, Toh & Gray (2007), 'Colour displays for categorical images', Color Research & Application
colormaps.license: colorcet — primarily Peter Kovesi's CET perceptually-uniform colour maps (CC-BY-4.0; Kovesi 2015 arXiv:1509.03700; https://colorcet.com) via the colorcet package by HoloViz (CC-BY-4.0; https://github.com/holoviz/colorcet)

colormaps.name: algae
colormaps.description: White → deep green. Monochromatic green PU sequential; fills the green-hue gap among single-hue scientific maps.
colormaps.license: cmocean by Kristen Thyng (MIT; https://github.com/matplotlib/cmocean)

colormaps.name: matter
colormaps.description: White → magenta/red-purple. Monochromatic pink/magenta PU sequential; useful where green/blue palettes are reserved for other channels.
colormaps.license: cmocean by Kristen Thyng (MIT; https://github.com/matplotlib/cmocean)

colormaps.name: tempo
colormaps.description: White → teal. Monochromatic cyan-teal PU sequential; cooler/cleaner than ice when high-chroma blues clash.
colormaps.license: cmocean by Kristen Thyng (MIT; https://github.com/matplotlib/cmocean)

colormaps.name: turbid
colormaps.description: White → brown/tan. Monochromatic earth-tone PU sequential; reads as 'sediment' or 'turbidity magnitude'.
colormaps.license: cmocean by Kristen Thyng (MIT; https://github.com/matplotlib/cmocean)

colormaps.name: desikan-killiany
colormaps.description: Desikan-Killiany cortical parcellation (aparc).
colormaps.license: raw — license tied to the source CSV; record per-entry

colormaps.name: dkt
colormaps.description: Desikan-Killiany-Tourville (DKT40) parcellation.
colormaps.license: raw — license tied to the source CSV; record per-entry

colormaps.name: destrieux
colormaps.description: Destrieux sulco-gyral parcellation (a2009s), 148 regions.
colormaps.license: raw — license tied to the source CSV; record per-entry

colormaps.name: brodmann
colormaps.description: Brodmann cytoarchitectonic areas, as shipped by Brainstorm.
colormaps.license: raw — license tied to the source CSV; record per-entry

colormaps.name: brodmann-thresh
colormaps.description: Brodmann areas, thresholded variant.
colormaps.license: raw — license tied to the source CSV; record per-entry

colormaps.name: structures
colormaps.description: Coarse structural split (the two hemispheres).
colormaps.license: raw — license tied to the source CSV; record per-entry
